title: An adaptive $L_2$-type test for high-dimensional white noise
abstract: arXiv:2609.33418v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a new $L_2$-type test for white noise which allows the dimension $p$ of the time series to either (i) be a fixed constant, or (ii) diverge with the sample size $n$. The proposed test statistic exhibits an interesting phase transition, following two different regimes of behavior: $p$ is fixed, and $p\rightarrow\infty$. Because identification of the operable regime is difficult, if not impossible in practice, we devise a novel adaptive bootstrap method to construct a unified testing procedure across different phases. Numerical experiments confirm the good finite sample performance of the proposed adaptive $L_2$-type test in comparison to the existing methods in the literature. The proposed testing procedure has been implemented in R package HDTSA.

translated_title: 一种针对高维白噪声的自适应 $L_2$ 型检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的白噪声 $L_2$ 型检验，该检验允许时间序列的维度 $p$ 既可以是固定常数，也可以随样本量 $n$ 发散。所提出的检验统计量呈现出一个有趣的相变现象，遵循两种不同的行为模式：$p$ 固定和 $p\rightarrow\infty$。由于在实际中识别可适用的渐近机制即使不是不可能也极为困难，我们设计了一种新颖的自适应自助（bootstrap）方法，以构建跨越不同阶段的统一检验程序。数值实验证实，与文献中现有方法相比，所提出的自适应 $L_2$ 型检验具有良好的有限样本表现。所提出的检验程序已在 R 包 HDTSA 中实现。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种适用于高维时间序列（维度可固定或随样本量发散）的自适应 $L_2$ 型白噪声检验，并通过新颖的自适应自助法构建了跨越不同渐近阶段的统一检验程序。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive $L_2$-type white noise test for high-dimensional time series (with dimension either fixed or diverging with sample size), using a novel adaptive bootstrap method to construct a unified testing procedure across different asymptotic regimes.
